task: Is fibre available at 12 Main Street?
golden: Fibre is available at 12 Main Street, for 60 USD a month.
candidate_a: Yes, fibre is available at 12 Main Street, at 60 dollars a month.
candidate_b: Fibre is not available at that address, only mobile internet.

golden: Acme Mobile M costs 25 USD a month and includes 40 GB.
candidate_a: Acme Mobile M costs 15 USD a month with 10 GB.
candidate_b: Acme Mobile M is 25 dollars a month with 40 GB of data.

task: Is the shop open on Saturday?
golden: The shop is open on Saturday from 9:00 to 17:00.
candidate_a: Yes, we are open on Saturday from nine in the morning until five.

task: How long is the Acme Air 5G contract?
golden: The Acme Air 5G contract is 24 months.

task: Can I change my delivery address?
golden: Yes, the delivery address can be changed until the order ships.

candidate_b: No, delivery addresses cannot be changed.

task: Do you ship to Belgium?

candidate_a: We deliver to Belgium, usually within three to five working days.

task: What is the late payment fee?
golden: The late payment fee is 5 USD per month overdue.
candidate_a: There is no late payment fee.
candidate_b: A late fee of 5 dollars applies for each month overdue.

task: Can I cancel my plan at any time?
golden: Yes, you can cancel at any time with no fee.
candidate_a: You may cancel whenever you like, without a fee.
candidate_b: Cancellation is only possible after 12 months, with a 100 USD fee.

golden: Use the reset link on the login page, then check your email.
candidate_a: Call the shop to have your password reset by a person.
candidate_b: Click reset on the login page and follow the link sent to your email.

task: Is there a student discount?

task: When will my order arrive?
